name: Sheshbazzar
bio: Sheshbazzar, prince of Judah, led the first group of exiles who returned from Babylon to Jerusalem under Cyrus's decree. Cyrus's treasurer Mithredath counted out to him the 5,400 gold and silver temple vessels Nebuchadnezzar had carried off, and Sheshbazzar brought them all up to Jerusalem along with the returning captives (Ezra 1:8-11). Tatnai's inquiry letter to Darius attributes the temple's foundation specifically to Sheshbazzar, whom Cyrus had made governor, rather than to Zerubbabel and Jeshua as Ezra 3 describes it (Ezra 5:14-16).
